answer_1.quote: We formulate all the tasks into a unified sequence-to-sequence format in which the input text, images, instructions, and bounding boxes are represented in the same token space.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates text outputs such as captions, selected regions (as tokenized bounding boxes), or answers to questions based on multimodal inputs.

answer_2.quote: We report the accuracy for classification tasks and ROUGE-L for all generation tasks.
